text: DEFONEOS — DWP Personal Independence Payment AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DWP × PIP DWP Personal Independence Payment AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK PIP — disability benefit for working-age adults (16-SPA). Daily Living (DL) and Mobility components, points-based assessment, mandatory reconsideration (MR), special rules terminal illness (SR1). 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Eligibility Eligibility — Age, Residency, Qualifying Period Age 16-SPA. UK resident. Habitual residence test. 3-month qualifying + 9-month prospective. Immigration control / NRPF exclusion. PIP replaces DLA for working-age claims. AA separate for SPA+. SRTI bypass qualifying period. NI number required. Daily Living Daily Living Component — 10 Descriptors, Points Threshold 10 descriptors: nutrition, washing, toilet, dressing, communicating, reading, engaging, budgeting, medication, bathing. Each 0-12 points. Standard 8+ pts, Enhanced 12+ pts. Needs-based: majority of days. Aided vs unaided. Safely, repeatedly, acceptable standard, reasonable time. Mobility Mobility Component — 2 Descriptors, Planning and Moving 2 descriptors: planning/following journeys, moving around. D1: cognitive, visual, psychological barriers. D2: physical — 50m benchmark, aids, wheelchair. Standard 8+ pts, Enhanced 12+ pts. Enhanced Mobility triggers Motability. Overlapping mobility awards excluded. Assessment Assessment Process — CHDA, Health Professional, Observation CHDA health professional. F2F, telephone, or video. Functional assessment against PIP descriptors. Evidence from GP, consultant, CPN, OT. PA3/PA4 report. HP recommendation vs DM decision. Paper-based where evidence sufficient. Home visits for mobility-restricted. PIP2 PIP2 Claim Form — 'How Your Disability Affects You' PIP2: 'How your disability affects you'. 28-day return. Evidence: GP/consultant letters, CPN statements, medication list, diary. Good days/bad days variability. Aids and appliances. Section 12 info. Phone alternative. Claim date = PIP call date. MR/Appeal Mandatory Reconsideration — 28-Day Request, Appeal Rights MR request within 28 days. DWP DM reviews. New evidence at MR. Partial decisions — component/level changes. Appeal to HMCTS First-tier Tribunal within 1 month. Late appeals up to 13 months. Oral or paper hearing. Tribunal can increase, decrease, or maintain. Upper Tribunal on point of law. Terminal Terminal Illness — SR1/SR2, Special Rules, Fast-Track SRTI. SR1/SR2 from GP/consultant. Death within 12 months. Enhanced DL + Enhanced Mobility auto-awarded. Fast-track under 48hrs. 3-year award. No qualifying period. No F2F assessment. Backdating to claim date. Rates Rates and Points — Weekly Payments, Thresholds, Uprating DL standard £72.65/wk, enhanced £108.55/wk. Mobility standard £28.70/wk, enhanced £75.75/wk. 8pts standard, 12pts enhanced. Both components payable. PIP DL overlaps with AA/CAA. PIP Mobility overlaps with DLA Mobility. Tax-free. Not means-tested. Annual CPI uprating. Reviews Reviews and Renewals — Light-Touch, CoC, DLA Transfer AR1 review. Light-touch at 10 years for stable conditions. CoC — worsening, new condition, hospital, prison. DLA to PIP migration. Award: ongoing or fixed-term (1-10 years). Review can increase, decrease, or maintain. ADP (Scotland) replacement. Passporting Passporting and Interactions — UC, Motability, Blue Badge PIP Enhanced DL → UC LCWRA. Carer premium for CA claimant. Motability: Enhanced Mobility lease. Blue Badge (Enhanced Mobility or 8+ pts DL 11/12). Bus pass. Winter Fuel top-up. Warm Home Discount. Council Tax reduction. HB disability premium. SDP/UC interaction.
